verdict.rationale: Lovable's project docs say the Code section lets you browse, edit, and download your app's source code inside the project, and the product is described as backed by editable code with file diffs visible for agent changes. Git sync offers local IDE editing as a complementary path. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the in-builder code editor (file navigation, editing workflow, plan limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration of direct in-builder editing.
